findings.explanation: Outside the domain, HOL4's FAPPLY f x is OUTL (fmap_REP f x) = OUTL (INR one). OUTL is specified only on INL (sumScript.sml:286), and the saved theorems give only f ' x = FEMPTY ' x (NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY). FEMPTY ' x is never related to THE NONE or ARB, and THE is itself specified only on SOME (optionScript.sml:176). Lean defines FAPPLY f x := THE (FLOOKUP f x), so it proves by rfl that FAPPLY FEMPTY x = THE none, and also that it equals ARB. HOL4 leaves both equations open. In-domain values agree.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque FAPPLY_undef {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] : β

noncomputable def FAPPLY [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match FLOOKUP f x with
  | some y => y
  | none => FAPPLY_undef
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.Fmap
open CmlTS

theorem chk1 {α β : Type} [Nonempty β] (x : α) :
    FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap α β) x = THE (none : Option β) := rfl

theorem chk2 {α β : Type} [Nonempty β] (x : α) :
    FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap α β) x = (ARB : β) := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?the:bool option -> bool. (!x. the (SOME x) = x) /\ the NONE <> FAPPLY (FEMPTY : num |-> bool) 0
